endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleIncidence_spherical_coefficient_le_threeFace_event
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {p m n : ℕ},
  1 ≤ p →
    ∀ (U : RectangleCLT.Face p → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)) (a : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Face p)
      (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (F : Fin 3 → Fin m) (hi : LinearIndependent ℝ fun i => U (a (F i)))
      (hu : ∀ (i : Fin 3), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (U (a (F i))) = 1),
      |inner (RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleIncidenceTransportPoint (fun k => U (a k)) b F)
                (2 •
                  ∫ (ω : ↑(Metric.sphere 0 1)) in
                    RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSphericalSection
                      (RectangleCLTArxivV1.trihedralGeneratedCone
                        (RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleIncidenceTransportBasis (fun k => U (a k)) F hi hu)),
                    ↑ω ∂MeasureTheory.volume.toSphere)| *
            RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleEuclideanDensity
              (RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleIncidenceTransportPoint (fun k => U (a k)) b F) *
          (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian (n + 1)).real
            {g |
              ∀
                k ∈
                  Finset.univ \
                    RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleFaceActive
                      (RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleIncidenceTransportTuple (fun k => U (a k)) F hi),
                RectangleCLT.faceDot (U (a k))
                    (RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleTransportSection
                      (RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleIncidenceTransportIsometry (fun k => U (a k)) F hi hu)
                      (RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleIncidenceTransportPoint (fun k => U (a k)) b F) g) <
                  b k} ≤
        6144 * Real.exp (3 / 2) *
          ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)),
            (RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleIncidenceTransportEvent (fun k => U (a k)) b F hi hu
                  (RectangleCLTArxivV1.fourthThreeFaceRadius U)).indicator
              (fun g => RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHRadius U g ^ 4) g ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian (n + 1)

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleIncidenceTransportEvent_integral_sum_le
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (R : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin r) → ℝ),
  Continuous R →
    (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin r)), 1 ≤ R x) →
      (∀ (x d : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin r)), R (x + d) ≤ R x + ‖d‖) →
        ∀ (hu : ∀ (k : Fin m), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u k) = 1),
          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun g => R (RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector g) ^ 4)
              (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) →
            ∑ F,
                ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                  (RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleIncidenceTransportEvent u b ↑F ⋯ ⋯ R).indicator
                    (fun g => R (RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector g) ^ 4) g ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r ≤
              6 *
                ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                  (RectangleCLTArxivV1.fourthOuterLayer u b R).indicator
                    (fun g => R (RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector g) ^ 4) g ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r
